instruction.name: xvhsubw.q.d
instruction.description: Subtract even-positioned signed 64-bit elements in `b` from odd-positioned signed 64-bit elements in `a`, sign-extending both to 128-bit, to get the 128-bit result.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 3.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvhsubw.q.d $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvhsubw.q.d $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvhsubw.q.d $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvhsubw.q.d $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvhsubw.q.d $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvhsubw.q.d $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvhsubw.q.d $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvhsubw.q.d $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
